description: Source code for adaptive average pooling functions in PyTorch's ATen library, specifically for quantized CPU tensors, including dispatch definitions, helper functions, and QNNPACK integration.

methods.name: start_index
methods.description: Calculates the start index on input matrix for pooling based on output index and sizes.

methods.name: end_index
methods.description: Calculates the end index on input matrix for pooling based on output index and sizes.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool_single_out_frame
methods.description: Performs adaptive average pooling for a single output frame for 2D/3D inputs.

methods.name: get_output_shape
methods.description: Determines the output shape for adaptive average pooling based on input tensor and desired output size.

methods.name: _adaptive_avg_pool
methods.description: Template function implementing adaptive average pooling for 2D or 3D tensors.

methods.name: enable_qnnpack_for_ada_avgpool
methods.description: Checks if QNNPACK can be used for adaptive average pooling based on input and output sizes.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool2d_quantized_cpu
methods.description: Public API for quantized 2D adaptive average pooling on CPU.

methods.name: adaptive_avg_pool3d_quantized_cpu
methods.description: Public API for quantized 3D adaptive average pooling on CPU.
